description: Every experiment behind a reported table or figure, the code that executes it, the command, its configurations and the artifacts it produces (artifact identifiers of release/paper_artifacts.json). scripts/statement_check.py verifies that every listed file exists and that every artifact a display needs has a producing experiment.

experiments.title: Eight-stage lifecycle of every dataset: prepare, train, explore, fit, select, confirm, admit, evaluate; separated data roles (E10), selection trace (E15), uncertainty hierarchy (E16), per-cell support (E19), Full/Lean profiles (E20)
experiments.command: bash run_cross_morse.sh reproduce   (one dataset: python -B run_cross_morse_<dataset>.py --profile full --device cuda)

experiments.command: python -B scripts/arm_campaign.py execute --manifest <campaign.json>; python -B scripts/export_records.py budget-matched
